name: wm
description: WhiteMagic meta-tool — sovereign cognitive kernel and memory hierarchy. Routes via thought=<natural language>, route=<tool id>, or discrete action.

thought.description: Natural language query or command auto-routed via NLU

title: WhiteMagic Meta-Tool

name: memory.create
description: Store a new memory in the holographic substrate with bijective UUID, 6D projection, and galaxy routing.

galaxy.description: Target memory galaxy: codex, active, audit, sessions (default: codex)

event_time.description: Optional event time: when the recorded event actually happened, as RFC 3339

title: Store Memory

name: memory.search
description: Search memories: hybrid BM25 + vector fusion with deterministic sub-millisecond retrieval.

query.description: Search query or natural language question

galaxy.description: Galaxy to search in, or 'all' for cross-galaxy discovery

limit.description: Maximum number of memories to return (default: 10)

historical.description: Include superseded or archived records (default: false)

since.description: Inclusive lower time bound: RFC3339 or epoch seconds

until.description: Inclusive upper time bound: RFC3339 or epoch seconds

min_score_ratio.description: Relative floor: reject hits below this fraction of the top score

cold_scan_limit.description: Maximum cold records to scan when include_cold is set (default 2048)

title: Search Memories

name: memory.read
description: Retrieve a specific memory by its numeric record ID or UUID string.

id.description: Unique identifier of the memory (UUID or numeric record_id)

title: Read Memory

name: memory.list
description: List memories with pagination (limit, offset) and galaxy filtering.

galaxy.description: Galaxy to list, or omit for all galaxies

limit.description: Maximum number of memories to return (default: 20)

exclude_tags.description: Drop memories carrying any of these tags

title: List Memories

name: memory.hybrid_recall
description: Compatibility alias of memory.search with BM25 + dense vector fusion.

since.description: Inclusive lower time bound: RFC3339 or epoch seconds

until.description: Inclusive upper time bound: RFC3339 or epoch seconds

min_score_ratio.description: Relative floor: reject hits below this fraction of the top score

cold_scan_limit.description: Maximum cold records to scan when include_cold is set (default 2048)

title: Hybrid Recall

name: galaxy.list
description: List all active sovereign memory galaxies, their record counts, sample tags, and starter guide status.
title: List Galaxies

name: galaxy.fork
description: Fork an existing galaxy partition into a new sovereign galaxy branch (e.g. 'guide' -> 'project-alpha').

source.description: Source galaxy name to fork from (e.g. 'guide')

title: Fork Galaxy

name: galaxy.create
description: Establish a new sovereign galaxy namespace with an initial genesis beacon.

description.description: Optional description of the galaxy's purpose

title: Create Galaxy

name: session.record
description: Record a session turn (decision, breakthrough, summary) for compounding continuity.

supersedes.description: Memory id of an earlier turn this record replaces

title: Record Session Turn

name: session.continuity
description: Recall where the previous session left off: recent turns, checkpoints, and open queues.

n.description: Number of recent turns to recall (default: 5)

since.description: Time-range floor: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

until.description: Time-range ceiling: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

title: Session Continuity

name: session.start
description: Start or resume an agent session for persistent continuity across tool invocations.
title: Start Session

name: memory.update
description: Update an existing memory: appends a revision into the cryptographic history chain.

id.description: Memory UUID or numeric record_id to update

title: Update Memory

name: memory.revisions
description: Inspect the tamper-evident revision chain of a memory.

id.description: Memory UUID or record_id to inspect

title: Memory Revisions

name: session.checkpoint
description: Save a structured checkpoint (git state, next queue, open flags) for lossless handoffs.

summary.description: High-density summary of decisions, state, and findings

data.description: Legacy free-form passthrough stored beside the handoff.

tests_green.description: Whether the test suite was green at checkpoint time.

lease_id.description: Claimed scope lease_id that remains held at this handoff

title: Session Checkpoint

name: memory.ingest
description: Ingest a folder or batch of documents/transcripts into the Substrate.

redact.description: Scrub credential-shaped content before storage (default true).

wait_secs.description: Wait up to N seconds for a busy store before failing.

title: Ingest Memories

name: receipts.emit
description: Refuses generic receipt emission. Use a supported typed receipt producer so the signed fields have defined semantics.

out.description: Optional file path to write receipt JSON

title: Emit Continuity Receipt

name: receipts.verify
description: Verify one supported WhiteMagic receipt profile against the existing local gate key. This is not a Continuity Receipt bundle verifier.

bundle.description: One supported signed WhiteMagic profile receipt object

title: Verify WhiteMagic Profile Receipt

name: memory.count
description: Count memories matching optional filters without returning full payload content.
title: Count Memories

name: memory.stats
description: Substrate statistics: epoch, total records, relations, postings, and crash-consistency invariants.
title: Memory Substrate Statistics

name: memory.tags
description: List the tag vocabulary with usage counts.

galaxy.description: Galaxy whose tags to list (optional; default codex)

title: Memory Tags Vocabulary

name: memory.aggregate
description: Aggregate a numeric or categorical field over matched memories.

query.description: Full-text query selecting the memories to aggregate over

title: Aggregate Memories

name: memory.associations
description: Traverse associative graph neighbours of a memory over spreading activation.

id.description: Source memory UUID or numeric record_id

title: Associative Graph Neighbours

name: memory.batch_read
description: Read multiple memories by their UUID or numeric record IDs in a single call.

ids.description: List of memory IDs (UUIDs or integers) to read

title: Batch Read Memories

name: memory.query
description: Structured query over memories with filters, ordering, and field projections.

tags.description: Filter: memories with all of these tags

created_after.description: Filter: only memories created at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp

created_before.description: Filter: only memories created at or before this RFC 3339 timestamp

title: Query Memories

name: memory.filter
description: Filter memories by metadata (tags, minimum importance, recency).

offset.description: Skip this many matching entries before returning (default 0)

query.description: Filter: every whitespace-separated term must appear

exclude_tags.description: Filter: drop memories carrying any of these tags

created_after.description: Filter: only memories created at or after this RFC 3339 timestamp

created_before.description: Filter: only memories created at or before this RFC 3339 timestamp

title: Filter Memories

name: memory.pin
description: Pin a critical memory against decay, sweep compaction, and forgetting.

id.description: Memory UUID or numeric record ID to pin

title: Pin Memory

name: memory.search_batch
description: Execute multiple memory search queries concurrently with sub-millisecond retrieval.
title: Batch Search Memories

name: session.list
description: List all active and historical agent sessions recorded in the substrate.
title: List Sessions

name: session.recall
description: Recall specific interactions and turns within a targeted session.
title: Recall Session Content

name: session.replay
description: Replay the chronological trajectory of a session for audit and debugging.

since.description: Time-range floor: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

until.description: Time-range ceiling: epoch seconds, RFC 3339, or YYYY-MM-DD

include_superseded.description: Also return turns replaced via supersedes (default false).

turn_types.description: Selective mode: turn types to keep

title: Replay Session

name: mandala.status
description: Status of the Mandala microsecond Landlock sandbox, ABI level, POSIX rlimit bounds, and capability ledger.
title: Mandala Kekkai Sandbox Status

name: mandala.triage
description: Non-autoregressive System 1 JEV/Layla triage gate (<30 ns) to classify tasks and predict marginal utility and confinement tier.

inquiry.description: Task or inquiry description to triage

title: Mandala JEV Triage Gate

name: mandala.evaluate
description: Execute a candidate mutation in an ephemeral Landlock sandboxed Kekkai and notarize with Spec 0.5 receipt.

candidate_id.description: Unique identifier for the mutation candidate

command.description: Optional command to execute within ephemeral sandbox

title: Mandala Confinement Evaluation

name: mesh_sync
description: Synchronize the Substrate with a remote peer node over the sovereign TCP protocol.
title: Mandala P2P Mesh Sync

name: gnosis.status
description: System epistemics, self-model calibration, and invariant health status.
title: Gnosis Self-Model Status

name: gnosis.explain
description: Explain internal architectural invariants, memory schemas, or routing logic.

args_hash.description: Hash of the arguments under evaluation

is_spawn.description: Claim: the invocation spawns a process

is_network.description: Claim: the invocation uses the network

has_purpose.description: Claim: the invocation carries a purpose

title: Gnosis Explain

name: sangha.status
description: Query live fleet status, unread mentions, and board post sequence from the local Sangha agora.
title: Sangha Whiteboard Status

name: sangha.inbox
description: Fetch unread mentions and dispatches targeted at an agent (default: 'antigravity').
title: Sangha Agent Inbox

name: sangha.post
description: Broadcast a structured dispatch to other local agents via the Sangha Whiteboard.
title: Sangha Dispatch Post

name: decision.shortlist
description: Rank candidate routes/actions for a state with the local static-embedding retrieval organ (no network, no model forward pass) and emit a signed shortlist receipt.

state.description: State to retrieve candidates for (text or JSON)

routes.description: Candidate set: {name: description} or {name: [utterances...]}; multi-utterance routes score by best match

catalog_path.description: Path to a JSON file with {name: description}; used when `routes` is absent

margin_threshold.description: Below this top1-top2 margin the gate is 'ambiguous' (default 0.02)

cascade.description: If ambiguous, cascade to System 1.5 Deliberator (default true)

session_id.description: Session id for the shortlist receipt

tenant_id.description: Tenant id for the shortlist receipt (default: local)

emit_receipt.description: Write a signed shortlist receipt to <store>/receipts (default true)

title: System 0.5 Route Shortlist (Static Embeddings)

name: decision.deliberate
description: Deliberate over ambiguous candidate options using local grammar-constrained SLM inference (100% schema guarantee, no hallucination) and emit a signed deliberation receipt.

candidates.description: Allowed candidate action names, objects, or map

emit_receipt.description: Write signed deliberation receipt to <store>/receipts (default true)

title: System 1.5 Local Deliberator (Grammar-Constrained SLM)

name: decision.outcome
description: Sign and journal the outcome of a dispatched decision/shortlist receipt (success, failure, corrected) for the learning loop.

receipt_path.description: Path to the subject receipt JSON under <store>/receipts

corrected_route.description: Correct route when the outcome is 'corrected'

title: Record Decision Outcome
